setPassword.title: Set your password
setPassword.intro: Enter your sign-in name and the code a Club Admin gave you, then choose a password.
setPassword.signOutFirst: Another member is signed in. Sign out before you set a password, so the code is applied to the right account.
setPassword.mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
setPassword.policy: The password was not set. The new password does not meet the password policy.
setPassword.codeInvalid: This code is expired, already used, or revoked. Contact a Club Admin for a new code.
setPassword.refused: The password was not set. Check your input and try again.
setPassword.unreachable: The platform is not reachable. Try again in a moment.
setPassword.error: Something went wrong while setting the password. Try again later.
setPassword.done: Your password is set. You can sign in now.

account.title: Account
account.mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
account.policy: The password was not changed. The new password does not meet the password policy.
account.refused: The password was not changed. Check your current password and try again.
account.unreachable: The platform is not reachable. Try again in a moment.
account.error: Something went wrong while changing the password. Try again later.
